claims.name: finitePart_convex_of_subdifferentiable

seven_slots.objects_spaces: Any real inner product space, not necessarily complete; f:E->EReal, V subset E. Source T2.21 uses f:R^d->R.
seven_slots.quantifiers: forall f,V satisfying premises; forall z in V exists g in E forall y in E support. The proper finite witness is global, not necessarily in V.
seven_slots.assumptions: Convex V; f nowhere bottom and finite somewhere; global supports at each feasible point. Supports plus properness force finite f on V.
seven_slots.conclusion_metric: ConvexOn R V (toReal o f), only restriction to V. No global convexity or claim about infinite values under conversion.
seven_slots.constants_normalization: Unit-coefficient support pairing; ordinary nonnegative convex weights summing to one.
seven_slots.boundary: V may be empty; f may be top outside V; toReal(top)=toReal(bottom)=0. Properness plus supports justifies conversion only on V.

claims.name: proximal_one_step_extended

seven_slots.objects_spaces: Complete real inner product E; extended loss, feasible V, ambient real psi, eta>0, center x and supplied minimizer p.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Global proper witness; forall z in V exists global supporting g; supplied p and hmin; conclusion forall u in V. No time-indexed selection or recursion.
seven_slots.assumptions: Convex V, proper f, global supports at all z in V, eta>0, p in V, actual Frechet differentiability of psi at both x and p, extended IsMinOn objective. No differentiability of f and no convexity/strict convexity of psi.
seven_slots.conclusion_metric: eta*(toReal(f p)-toReal(f u)) <= D(psi,u,x)-D(psi,u,p)-D(psi,p,x). Both negative residuals and ordered arguments preserved.
seven_slots.constants_normalization: Objective eta^-1*D; conclusion eta times loss difference. Three-point RHS = (dpsi(p)-dpsi(x))(u-p), no missing factor or reversed sign.
seven_slots.probability_feedback: One-step deterministic conditional inequality. Receive-loss-before-update causal semantics are not asserted.
seven_slots.boundary: x can be outside V and dom f; p,u finite by proper/support assumptions. No existence, uniqueness, ambient extension, interior preservation, source-domain embedding, telescoping, full regret or nonpositive-regret conclusion.

definition_audit.finding: Global test domain matches source. Project definition is total even for improper f, but every production use needing source semantics has properness or finite-loss assumptions. No claimed source meaning for improper off-regime inputs.
